title: Study
description: M03 spec §10, ADR 0031 D7 (Amendment 1): one study over a compiled problem's pinned inputs — a sensitivity (§3), a sweep (§6) or an estimation (§7) — with the base problem's identity, its parameters and outputs, what it was asked and its result. The `$defs` are the records the study runtime emits (`openflowsheet.studies`). Rules a JSON Schema cannot express — a refused column's values are `null`, `status` agrees with `refusals`, a `determined: false` parameter carries no standard error — are checked beside it by `tests/test_m03_schemas.py`. Round-trip fixtures are emitted by real runs (`scripts/m03_schema_fixtures.py`).

model.description: The base problem's identity; for a sweep and a fit, the flowsheet before any pinned input is moved.

study_parameter.description: ADR 0031 D1, spec §3.1: a pinned input of the compiled problem, declared by the study with a scale and a finite domain `[lower, upper]` (recorded; no qualification reads it).

output_functional.description: Spec §2: a variable, or a linear functional `{variable_id: coefficient}` of them, with its scale.

sensitivity_result.description: Spec §3.7, ADR 0031 D3-D4: an implicit sensitivity under `M03-sensitivity-v1`, or its typed refusal. A refused request or column carries `null` values, never zeros; that and the agreement of `status` with `refusals` are checked beside the schema (`tests/test_m03_schemas.py`).

identity.description: The pairing identity of the base evaluation at `x*` (ADR 0008 D2).

alias_residual.description: Q3's scaled tangent residual; null when not evaluated.

outcomes.description: Spec §3.5's table, every row, in its order (Q2′ included).

prefixItems.description: Amendment 1: the solves on the qualified target pass ADR 0004 D3 — the forward solve, and in modes `adjoint` and `both` the transposed solve. `not_evaluated` when Q2 did not pass. A failure is the request refusal `LINEAR_SOLVE_FAILED` with ADR 0004's reason.

oneOf.description: Rows the outputs, columns the parameters; `null` in every refused column (or everywhere).
Rows the outputs, columns the parameters; `null` in every refused column (or everywhere).
Mode `both` (spec §3.6, Amendment 1): recorded, never a refusal; `QUALIFIED` does not imply `within_tolerance`.

items.description: ADR 0004 D3.1's record of one completed solve: the forward one, then the transposed one.

sweep_point.description: Spec §6: one point of a sweep. A failed or unrun point is a result: its outputs and sensitivity are `null`.

outcome.description: `CONVERGED` (solved and certified `VERIFIED`), a K03 solve outcome, `SPECIFICATION_REFUSED`, `CERTIFICATE_NOT_VERIFIED`, or `NOT_RUN`.

sweep_result.description: Spec §6, ADR 0031 D5 (Amendment 1): independent certified solves in input order; the only budget is a point count, and points beyond it are `NOT_RUN`.

estimation_report.description: Spec §7.4, ADR 0031 D6: a weighted least-squares fit, its identifiability and its validation. Data generated from the model are numerical verification, not empirical validation. An undetermined parameter's `final_iterate` is provenance only (Amendment 1); it carries no estimate and no standard error.

estimator.description: Spec §7.3's pinned settings, as the run used them.

estimator_result.description: `least_squares`'s result; empty when the fit failed inside it.
